question: Which Indian javelin thrower won the Ostrava Golden Spike event in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, India's premier **javelin thrower** and **Olympic gold medalist**, emerged victorious at the **Ostrava Golden Spike** event held in **2025** in the **Czech Republic**.
 
• The **Ostrava Golden Spike** is a highly prestigious **World Athletics Continental Tour Gold** meeting that attracts top-tier global talent in track and field. ***Hence, the statement regarding his victory is correct.***
 
• Chopra has a consistent history with this venue; in the **2024** edition of the same meet, he secured a **second-place** finish with a best throw of **88.36 meters**, finishing just behind Germany's Julian Weber.
 
• His participation and victory in the **2025** season highlight his continued dominance in the sport and his preparation for major global championships.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** remains the only **Indian athlete** to have won a **gold medal** in **athletics** at the **Olympic Games**, a feat he achieved at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Career Milestones:** **Neeraj Chopra** became the **World Champion** in **2023** by winning the **gold medal** at the **World Athletics Championships** in **Budapest** with a throw of **88.17 meters**.
 
• **Personal Best:** His national record and personal best stands at **89.94 meters**, which he achieved at the **Stockholm Diamond League** in **June 2022**.
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Kishore Kumar Jena**: An Indian javelin thrower who rose to prominence by winning the **silver medal** at the **2022 Hangzhou Asian Games** with a throw of **87.54 meters**.
 
• **Annu Rani**: India's leading **female javelin thrower** who won the **gold medal** at the **2022 Asian Games**, becoming the first Indian woman to do so in this discipline.
 
• **Rohit Yadav**: A promising Indian athlete who has represented the country in the **World Athletics Championships** and reached the finals in **2022**.
 
 
 
• **World Rankings:** In **May 2023**, **Neeraj Chopra** achieved the **World Number 1** ranking in the **Men's Javelin Throw** category for the first time in his career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Recognition:** For his exceptional contribution to sports, the **Government of India** conferred the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna** upon him in **2021** and the **Padma Shri** (India's fourth-highest civilian award) in **2022**.
 
• **Military Service:** **Neeraj Chopra** serves as a **Subedar** in the **4 Rajputana Rifles** of the **Indian Army**, having been recruited under the sports quota in **2016**.
 
• **Training:** He has been primarily coached by **Dr. Klaus Bartonietz**, a **German bio-mechanics expert**, who has played a pivotal role in refining his technique.
 
• **Historic Feats:** He is the only second Indian after **Abhinav Bindra** to win an individual **Olympic gold medal** and the first to win it in a **track and field** event.
